T&S MUSCLE
LET'S SET YOU UP RIGHT
💪
TRAIN SMARTER,
NOT HARDER
T&S Muscle is an adaptive lifting program. It tracks how hard you work each set and adjusts your weights automatically — so you're always training at the right intensity.
📈
EFFORT-BASED
PROGRESSION
After each set you'll log your RPE — how hard it felt on a scale of 1–10. That one number is what makes the app smart. It drives your weight adjustments, your weekly volume targets, and when the app decides you need a recovery week. The more consistently you log it, the more precisely the app works for you.
RPE 7Could do 3+ more reps
RPE 8 ✓ targetCould do 2 more reps
RPE 9Could do 1 more rep
RPE 10Max effort — nothing left
⚙️
2-MINUTE SETUP
You'll pick your goal, your training split, and your starting exercises. Week 1 is a calibration week — the app will dial in your weights after your first few sessions.

You can change anything at any time inside the app.

YOUR GOAL
This sets your rep targets for every exercise in the program.
Not sure? Size means moderate weight for more reps — great for adding muscle. Strength means heavier weight for fewer reps — builds raw force. Both is the popular middle ground if you want a bit of each.

RECOVERY WEEKS
The app schedules a lighter week roughly every 8 weeks — or earlier if your training load gets high. You can take a light training week at 75% weight, or a full rest. Most people feel better for it.
Consult a qualified medical professional before beginning any new exercise program, especially if you have a pre-existing health condition or injury.
PAUSE YOUR PROGRAM
Your week counter and streak will freeze until you resume. One pause is allowed per cycle — max 2 weeks.
SELECT A REASON
You've already used your pause for this cycle. Pauses reset when you start a new cycle.
PAUSE HERE
STEP 1 OF 3 · ACKNOWLEDGE
Something got in the way of your training. Before anything else — just notice that. Don't push it away, don't spiral into it. Just sit with it for a second.
"This is a moment of struggle. Struggle is part of the human experience. I don't have to pretend it's not there."
What's actually going on for you right now?
YOU'RE NOT ALONE
STEP 2 OF 3 · COMMON HUMANITY
Every person who trains goes through this. Every single one. The most consistent athletes in the world have weeks where it falls apart.
"Missing sessions doesn't mean I'm failing. It means I'm human. The people I look up to have been exactly here."
What would you say to a friend going through the exact same thing?
BE KIND TO YOURSELF
STEP 3 OF 3 · SELF-KINDNESS
You don't need to earn your way back. You can just come back. One session. That's all it takes to break a slump.
"I don't need to punish myself. I can simply decide what comes next — and that decision doesn't need to be perfect, just forward."
REMEMBER WHY YOU TRAIN
When will you train next? (Implementation intention — proven to 2-3x follow-through)
COGNITIVE REFRAME
LET'S WORK THROUGH THIS
WHAT'S YOUR INNER VOICE SAYING?
STEP 1 OF 4 · IDENTIFY THE THOUGHT
Before we dig into what happened — notice what your mind is telling you right now. These thoughts show up fast and feel like facts. They're usually not.
STEP 2 OF 4 · WHAT GOT IN THE WAY?
What got in the way?
STEP 3 OF 4 · CHOOSE YOUR RESPONSE
What's one small thing you could do instead — or next time?
Even 10 minutes counts. Be honest with yourself.
STEP 4 OF 4 · YOUR REFRAME
ON THAT THOUGHT

INSTALL T&S MUSCLE
Follow these steps to add to your home screen:
1
Make sure you're in Safari — PWA install only works in Safari on iPhone
2
Tap the Share button (the box with an arrow pointing up) at the bottom of Safari
3
Scroll down in the share sheet and tap "Add to Home Screen"
4
Tap "Add" — T&S Muscle will appear on your home screen
💡 Not in Safari? Copy the URL, open Safari, paste it in the address bar, then follow the steps above.
1
Make sure you're in Chrome — the install option only appears in Chrome
2
Tap the three-dot menu ⋮ in the top right, then tap "Install app"
3
Tap "Install" — T&S Muscle will appear in your app drawer like a normal app
💡 Don't see "Install app"? Chrome may not show it until you've visited the site a couple of times, or it may already be installed.
⚠️
RESTORE DEFAULTS?
This will undo all permanent exercise swaps and restore the original program. This cannot be undone.
WHAT IS RPE?
Rate of Perceived Exertion — how hard a set felt on a 1–10 scale. Log it after every set so the app can track your effort over time.
RPE 6 — 4+ reps left
RPE 7 — 3 reps left
RPE 8 — 2 reps left
RPE 9 — 1 rep left
RPE 10 — absolute max, nothing left
HOW IT AFFECTS YOUR WEIGHTS
Logging RPE 9–10 consistently tells the app you're near your limit — it slows down weight increases to keep you safe.

Logging RPE 6–7 signals you have room to grow — the app pushes weight up faster.

No RPE logged? The app defaults to RPE 8 for calculations — close, but your data is always more accurate.
